_schema.id: kebab-case unique id (node id becomes procedure:<id>)
_schema.name: short human name
_schema.trigger: when to run it — quoted phrases are explicit triggers
_schema.steps: ordered list of concrete steps (step 1 is the entry command)
_schema.source: note path(s) documenting the procedure -> 'documents' edges
_schema.links: list of rule:/procedure:/note ids -> 'applies' or 'concerns' edges

procedures.name: Deploy the website
procedures.trigger: "deploy the site" or after merging to the main branch
steps: Run the test suite and confirm it is green
Upload the bundle to the hosting provider
Smoke-test the live homepage and one deep link

procedures.name: Weekly backup
procedures.trigger: "run the backup" or every Sunday morning
steps: Export the database to a dated archive
Copy the archive to two independent locations
Verify the archive opens and spot-check one record
